Official operator search result describes two outdoor pools. Does not establish shape, size or position.

Official photograph inspected: straight pool edges, broad paved court, yellow cabanas/umbrellas, palms, low screen wall. Does not establish surveyed dimensions.
Official reverse photograph inspected: curved basin with inward deck projection, palms, seating and east-wing mural. Source artwork is reference only, not reusable texture.
Inspected and rejected as architectural reference: close pool lifestyle image shows no basin boundary.
